scripts.Page_Played:
(if ((eq #page #this)
     (block 
          (WADrawPage #initiator)
          (enum (WAGetPlayers) Player
                (enum (WAGetSuperstars Player) Superstar
                      (block 
                           (sett SpecialsInPlay 0)
                           (enum (WAPagesInPlay) Specials
                                 (if ((and (WAIsSpecial Specials)
                                           (eq (WAGetPlayedBy Specials) Superstar)
                                      )
                                      (sett SpecialsInPlay (add SpecialsInPlay 1))
                                     )
                                 )
                           )
                           (sett PlaybookSize (count (WAGetPlaybook Superstar)))
                           (if ((greater PlaybookSize SpecialsInPlay)
                                (sett ToRemove SpecialsInPlay)
                               )
                               (True
                                (sett ToRemove PlaybookSize)
                               )
                           )
                           (if ((greater ToRemove 0)
                                (WAMessage (WAGetOwner Superstar) "Jim Ross:" (WAGetName #this) "has forced you to ditch" ToRemove "page(s) from your playbook.")
                               )
                           )
                           (loop (greater ToRemove 0)
                                 (block 
                                      (WADitchFromPlaybook Superstar 0)
                                      (sett ToRemove (subtract ToRemove 1))
                                 )
                           )
                           (sett Buried 0)
                           (sett Hand (WAGetHand Superstar))
                           (sett HandIndex (count Hand))
                           (loop (greater HandIndex 0)
                                 (block 
                                      (if ((and (WAIsSpecial (item Hand HandIndex))
                                                (not (eq (item Hand HandIndex) #this))
                                           )
                                           (block 
                                                (sett PageTaken (WAMovePageFromHandToPlaybook Superstar (subtract HandIndex 1) -1))
                                                (WAMessage -1 (WAGetName #this) "has buried" (cat (WAGetNAme Superstar) "'s") (WAGetName PageTaken))
                                                (sett Buried (add Buried 1))
                                           )
                                          )
                                      )
                                      (sett HandIndex (subtract HandIndex 1))
                                 )
                           )
                           (if ((greater Buried 0)
                                (block 
                                     (sett PlaybookSize (count (WAGetPlaybook Superstar)))
                                     (if ((greater PlaybookSize Buried)
                                          (sett ToAdd Buried)
                                         )
                                         (True
                                          (sett ToAdd PlaybookSize)
                                         )
                                     )
                                     (loop (greater ToAdd 0)
                                           (block 
                                                (sett Drew (WADrawPage Superstar))
                                                (if ((not (eq Drew 0))
                                                     (WAMessage (WAGetOwner Superstar) "Jim Ross: You drew" (WAGetName Drew))
                                                    )
                                                )
                                                (sett ToAdd (subtract ToAdd 1))
                                           )
